style.title: Choose your research style
style.subtitle: Your research style affects how reports emphasize risk metrics, momentum signals, macro context, or catalyst analysis. This does not generate trade recommendations.

items.label: Risk-Controlled
items.description: I prioritize capital preservation. Research should emphasize drawdown risk, correlations, and defensive positioning.

items.label: Momentum
items.description: I follow trends and price momentum. Research should highlight trend strength, volume confirmation, and continuation signals.

items.label: Macro-Sensitive
items.description: I care about macro, rates, and liquidity cycles. Research should incorporate DXY, yields, and Fed policy context.

items.label: Event-Driven
items.description: I trade based on catalysts, news, and on-chain events. Research should surface event risks and scenario analysis.

items.label: High Beta
items.description: I seek higher-risk setups in volatile assets. Research should flag convex payoff opportunities and liquidation clusters.
